def load_user_events(user_id: str, since_ts: int = 0) -> list[dict]:
    """Read from the read-only replica, never the primary."""
    rows = db.query(READ_ONLY_DSN, "select * from user_events where user_id = %s", user_id)
    return [r for r in rows if r["created_at"] >= since_ts]  # __init__ ok
